attributes.body_ja:
名詞（めいし）の「機（き）」を含（ふく）む「を機（き）に」は、何（なに）かを行（おこな）うのに適（てき）したタイミングやチャンスを表（あらわ）す、やや改（あらた）まった表現（ひょうげん）です。一般的（いっぱんてき）には「(A) をきっかけに (B)」という意味（いみ）で使（つか）われますが、この文型（ぶんけい）は副助詞（ふくじょし）「を」、名詞（めいし）「機（き）」、格助詞（かくじょし）「に」からできており、話（はな）し手（て）が (A) を積極的（せっきょくてき）に利用（りよう）する・(A) のタイミングをうまく活（い）かすというニュアンスがあります。

「を機（き）に」は、(A) を表（あらわ）す名詞（めいし）の直後（ちょくご）に置（お）かれ、その出来事（できごと）を良（よ）い機会（きかい）として (B) のような行動（こうどう）を起（お）こしたときに使（つか）われます。

この表現（ひょうげん）は、特（とく）に (A) が動機（どうき）や口実（こうじつ）となって、話（はな）し手（て）が自（みずか）ら (B) することを選（えら）んだ場合（ばあい）に使（つか）われることが多（おお）いです。
attributes.body:
When used as a noun, 機（き） ‘opportunity’ indicates a time that is being used as suitable chance to do something. It is slightly formal and will usually be translated as ‘on the occasion of (A), (B)’. However, due to this grammar point being a construction of the adverbial particle を, 機（き）, and the case-marking particle に, it is indicating that the speaker is actively making use of the opportunity of (A)’. Due to this, it can be understood as ‘taking advantage of (A), (B)’, or ‘taking advantage of the time of (A), (B)’ on many occasions.

を機（き）に will directly follow nouns marking (A), before going on to explain how that (A) was utilized as an opportunity.

を機（き）に tends to be used most frequently when (B) is an action that the speaker is choosing to take primarily with (A) as the enabling factor, or being a good excuse.

These expressions are relatively synonymous in meaning and both refer to a sense of 'on the occasion of' or 'using this as an opportunity'. They are interchangeable in many situations but differ in that を機会に can be found in many variant patterns like を機会（に・と）して, and so forth, while を機に is usually found in a very specific pattern.
